fields.options:
💬 Sales Invoice WhatsApp Notification Guide
When clicking Send Invoice on a Sales Invoice or inside the Technician Portal, the system contacts AskEva's send-message API.

⚠️ Meta 24-Hour Policy & Send Modes:
• Template Message (Recommended): Can be sent anytime, even outside the 24h customer window. Requires an approved Meta template.
• Direct Text Message: Only works if the customer has messaged your WhatsApp business number in the last 24 hours. Outside 24h, Meta rejects with Session is not opened.

📝 Creating Templates in AskEva / Meta Dashboard:
Meta templates must use numbered variables like {{1}}, {{2}}, {{3}}. Do not use named variables like {customer_name} in the Meta template editor, or Meta will reject it with INVALID_FORMAT.

Supported Placeholders in Parameter Mapping:
• {customer_name}: Customer or business name
• {invoice_no}: Sales Invoice number (e.g. SI/26/HR/001)
• {amount}: Formatted invoice grand total (e.g. ₹1,500.00)
• {payment_mode}: Mode of payment (UPI, Cash, etc.)
• {technician_name}: Assigned technician
• {ticket_no}: Linked HD Ticket ID
• {company_name}: Company name
• {pdf_link}: Secure public PDF download link
